headline: IRGC: Supertanker Algaya Engulfed in Flames After Reportedly Striking Naval Mine in Strait of Hormuz

predictions.mechanism: A reported tanker mine strike in Hormuz raises oil-supply and geopolitical risk, pressuring broad equities through inflation and risk-off channels.
predictions.invalidation: Rapid official disconfirmation, containment without shipping disruption, and a sharp reversal lower in crude oil.

predictions.mechanism: Higher oil and inflation risk reinforce already-high discount rates and pressure long-duration technology equities.
predictions.invalidation: Rapid official disconfirmation or a clear fall in oil, yields and volatility.

predictions.mechanism: Fresh Hormuz escalation can trigger safe-haven demand for gold despite the competing headwind from a firm dollar and high yields.
predictions.invalidation: De-escalation combined with continued dollar/yield strength and no follow-through in oil or volatility.
